title: Harden guarded ingest dispatcher
summary: Harden guarded ingest with operation identity, scratch reservation, dry-run fingerprint, Python-side enabled-stage checks, and strict injected operation-journal evidence.
reason: Prevent replay, stale execute payloads, disabled-stage subprocess spawns, and unjournaled guarded ingest execution.
behavior_before: Ingest execute had no operation binding or required strict operation journal; disabled stages reached the PowerShell entrypoint before rejection.
behavior_after: Ingest execute requires a UUID operation ID, matching reservation/fingerprint, and strict operation journal adapter; disabled stages are rejected before spawn and PowerShell revalidates the fingerprint.
manual_validation: Representative real-media validation remains required before accepting this high-risk source-to-scratch change.
rollback_plan: Revert the guarded dispatcher contract and entrypoint changes together; no production Local API route was added.
notes:
Add ingest operation identity, reservation, and fingerprint contract.
Enforce enabled-stage and orchestration-only metadata.
Add strict operation journal and replay guard.
Validate ingest fingerprint and hardened boundaries.
Cover ingest intent fields and disabled stage guard.
Cover strict journal and duplicate operation handling.
Cover ingest dry-run/execute fingerprint boundary.
Regenerate guarded ingest stage schema.
Label disabled mutation DTOs as descriptive only.
Regenerate orchestration-only stage map.
Cover published dispatcher ownership contract.
